text: And nobody else has anything green?” “No, sir—not that I know of.” Poirot’s face did not betray a trace of whether he was disappointed or otherwise. He merely remarked: “Good, we will leave that and pass on. Have you any reason to believe that your mistress was likely to take a sleeping powder last night?” “Not last night, sir, I know she didn’t.” “Why do you know so positively?” “Because the box was empty. She took the last one two days ago, and she didn’t have any more made up.” “You are quite sure of that?” “Positive, sir.” “Then that is cleared up!
